title: Concept: Replication shortfall disclosed
description: A partition replication report with a non-zero under-replicated count in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The report says the event backbone is running degraded, which is an availability signal an attacker can use to time an operation on a cluster that cannot fail over.
applicability: Deployments that render a partition replication report with a non-zero under-replicated count into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The report says the event backbone is running degraded, which is an availability signal an attacker can use to time an operation on a cluster that cannot fail over.
